exposure: Educational program for healthcare team and women with GDM
Coordination between primary care units and highly complex maternity facilities
cohort: Pregnant women with gestational diabetes (GDM) who completed control visits from their first appointment until delivery, recruited in Corrientes and Buenos Aires, Argentina.
finding: The educational intervention and management changes significantly reduced maternal BMI and gestational weight gain, newborn body weight, and showed a trend towards fewer maternal triglycerides and macrosomia.
mod_finding: The intervention group showed a trend towards lower caesarean sections.
followup_time: Until delivery, with an unspecified duration for increased postnatal attendance for metabolic assessment.
birth_weight: Newborn's body weight was measured, with a trend towards fewer macrosomia.
